invariants.rationale: It is standard for API methods to expect non-null lists; by contract, collections are often non-null on entry.
instantTime is typically a required timestamp string for write operations, and should not be null.
A valid instantTime should be a non-empty string representing a commit timestamp.
If records is empty, its size is by definition zero or more; this checks consistency.
The list of records is expected to contain only non-null record objects for correct processing.
